theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_sobolev_perimeter
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), IsOpen D → MeasurableSet F → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → ∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ D → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z) → (∫ z in F, ζ z ^ ((m + 1 : ℝ) / m)) ^ ((m : ℝ) / (m + 1)) ≤ c * (∫ z, ζ z ∂μ + ∫ z in F, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z‖)
